experiment_data.hypothesis: X-VLA uses a linear projection connector (simpler than OpenVLA's 2-layer MLP), so its vision tokens may exhibit different compressibility patterns — potentially more uniform attention distribution and higher tolerance to pruning due to less non-linear feature mixing in the connector.
